name: gdp-lean-twin
cmd: cd lean-kernel && TC=$HOME/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.34.0 && export LEAN_PATH=$PWD:$TC/lib/lean && T=$(mktemp -d) && for f in Cert Kernel Progress History; do s=$(date +%s.%N); lean -o $f.olean $f.lean > /dev/null || exit 1; echo "built $f.olean (once, shared by every rule): $(echo "$(date +%s.%N) - $s" | bc) s"; done && s=$(date +%s.%N) && bun ../compare/twin.ts > $T/Compare.lean && echo "exported the three rules' trees: $(echo "$(date +%s.%N) - $s" | bc) s, $(wc -l < $T/Compare.lean) lines of Lean data" && s=$(date +%s.%N) && lean $T/Compare.lean; c=$?; echo "lean Compare.lean (budget, caps, window), exit $c: $(echo "$(date +%s.%N) - $s" | bc) s"; exit $c

name: typecheck
cmd: bun install 2>&1 | tail -1 && s=$(date +%s.%N) && bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p compare 2>&1; c=$?; echo "tsc -p compare (the gdp-wired rule files, run.ts, twin.ts) exit $c: $(echo "$(date +%s.%N) - $s" | bc) s"; exit $c
